description_en: Deletes a multi-zone instance by calling the DeleteMultiZoneCluster operation
description_zh: 通过DeleteMultiZoneCluster接口删除多可用区实例
kebab_example: aliyun hbase delete-multi-zone-cluster --cluster-id d-t4nn71xa0yn560000 --immediate-delete-flag false --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteMultiZoneCluster

parameters.help_en: The ID of the multi-zone cluster to delete
parameters.help_zh: 要删除的多可用区集群Id
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to immediately delete the instance. By default, the instance is moved to the recycle bin and permanently deleted after 7 days. Valid values:
- true: Immediately deletes the instance without moving it to the recycle bin. Use this option with caution.
- false: Moves the instance to the recycle bin. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否立即删除实例（默认是走回收站，7日后完全清理）
- true：立即删除， 不走回收站，慎重提交。
- false：不立即删除，走回收站， 默认
parameters.name: immediate_delete_flag
